in_hebrew.name: Ginnifer
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ginnifer הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word γυνηφορός (gynēphorós), meaning ‘woman-bearer’ or ‘bringer of women’. The name Ginnifer may be a variant of Guinevere or Gwendolyn, both meaning ‘fair one’ or ‘white wave’.

The name Ginnifer may be a variant of Guinevere or Gwendolyn, both meaning ‘fair one’ or ‘white wave’.
